text: Based on the evidence, we can certify with high confidence that no fire occurred on this asset during the period from October 6, 2026, to November 5, 2026. The analysis used NASA FIRMS data from multiple sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS), which provided continuous coverage of the asset throughout the entire period. No thermal anomalies or active fire detections were recorded within the asset's boundaries. The strict coverage rule ensured that every day was monitored by all sensors, leaving no gaps in detection. Therefore, it is safe to conclude that no fire activity took place on the asset during this time.
